biomarkers.name: WHO grade (1, 2, 3)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Drives prognosis and adjuvant RT decisions

biomarkers.name: NF2 mutations / loss of chromosome 22
biomarkers.clinical_use: Most common driver; NF2 syndrome predisposes to multiple meningiomas and schwannomas

biomarkers.name: TERT promoter mutations
biomarkers.prevalence: Rare (~5% overall; enriched in higher-grade tumors) and upgrades to WHO grade 3 in CNS5
biomarkers.clinical_use: Molecular criterion for grade 3 regardless of morphology

biomarkers.name: CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion
biomarkers.prevalence: Rare overall, enriched in aggressive tumors; upgrades to grade 3

biomarkers.name: H3K27me3 loss
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse prognostic marker, particularly in higher-risk/grade 2 meningioma

biomarkers.name: SMO, AKT1, PIK3CA, TRAF7, KLF4 mutations (non-NF2 subgroup)
biomarkers.prevalence: Common in non-NF2 meningiomas; often location- and subtype-associated (especially skull base/olfactory groove; secretory subtype for TRAF7/KLF4)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Molecular subclassification; potential targeted therapy trials

biomarkers.name: Somatostatin receptor 2 (SSTR2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Useful diagnostically by IHC; DOTATATE PET useful for post-op residual and recurrence; PRRT under clinical evaluation

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Meningothelial cells arising from arachnoid cap cells; whorls and psammoma bodies characteristic
histomorphological_subtype.grading: WHO grade 1, 2, or 3; molecular criteria (TERT, CDKN2A/B) can upgrade regardless of morphology

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Grade 1 minimally inflamed; grade 3 more inflammatory infiltrate
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Characteristic whorls; psammoma bodies (calcification); attachment to dura

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Meningothelial (arachnoid cap) cells of the leptomeninges
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neural crest and mesoderm (dual embryonic contribution to meninges  cranial meninges from neural crest and mesoderm; spinal meninges predominantly from mesoderm)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Meningothelial differentiation (EMA+, SSTR2+, progesterone receptor+) with characteristic whorled architecture and psammoma bodies; variable morphologic subtypes (meningothelial, fibrous, transitional, psammomatous, angiomatous, microcystic, secretory, chordoid, clear cell, papillary, rhabdoid)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Molecular classification increasingly overrides morphology: NF2/22q loss (most common), TRAF7-KLF4 (secretory), AKT1 (skull base), SMO (skull base), POLR2A, PIK3CA, BAP1 (aggressive rhabdoid); CDKN2A/B loss and TERT promoter mutations define grade 3-like biology regardless of morphology
